description: This plot illustrates the "Hidden State Mean," showing the absolute mean values across different layers for a baseline and conditions before and after a gate. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with numeric tick labels regularly spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean," also on a linear scale, with values ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5 and tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. The plot features three lines, all without markers. The first line, labeled "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," is a blue dashed line that starts at approximately 0.05 at layer 0, rises gradually with minor fluctuations to roughly 0.45 at layer 17, and then exhibits a sharp upward trend, reaching about 0.9 at layer 19, spiking to 2.6 at layer 21, and ending at a peak of approximately 4.3 at layer 23. The second line, labeled "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," is an orange dotted line that begins near 0 at layer 0 and maintains a nearly flat, steady trajectory, gradually reaching approximately 0.1 at layer 23. The third line, labeled "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04," is a green solid line that also starts near 0 at layer 0 and remains steady and flat across the entire x-axis, concluding at roughly 0.1 at layer 23.
